paragraphs: Your body’s natural microbiome of helpful bacteria can become unbalanced from a poor diet or other factors, causing unpleasant symptoms and affecting your daily life. California Gold Nutrition Cran-Max® LactoBif® Probiotic combines probiotics with a bioavailable cranberry concentrate to support digestive and urinary tract health.*

This unique formula contains 8 active and clinically researched probiotic strains, including 5 Lactobacilli and 3 Bifidobacteria.¹ When taken on a regular basis, probiotics may help balance intestinal flora which is key for digestive health and overall well being.*

In addition, this supplement features Cran-Max®, a pure and natural cranberry concentrate that may help promote a healthy urinary tract. Cran-Max® is delivered by a patented delivery system called Bio-Shield® Technology, which protects the concentrate as it passes through the digestive system until it reaches the lower gastrointestinal tract where it can be better absorbed.*

California Gold Nutrition Cran-Max® LactoBif Probiotics contains probiotics and cranberry concentrate in veggie capsules. They are individually-sealed in double-foil blister packaging, which helps protect the ingredients and makes this product shelf-stable with no need for refrigeration.2

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 capsule daily, with or without food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.

Individually Double-Foil Blister Sealed for quality and your protection. Do not use if blister pack material is punctured or missing. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
